about_the_game:
The demo version offers a PvE mode where you can face off against artificial intelligence. The game is currently in an early stage of development, but our team wants to showcase our progress and gather your feedback. We strive to improve this product.

Currently, the game features an RTS mode, detailed settings promised for the full version, including frame generation. Additionally, the game includes a system for detailed building destruction and a missile targeting mode.

The demo version includes only one map and has limited construction capabilities. These restrictions will certainly be removed in the full version.

Thank you for your support and trust!

content_descriptors.notes:
Disclamer: 
When murdering enemies in the game, you can see a lot of blood, and even torn limbs of your enemies or even the allied troops.

name: Ukrainian Shield: Iraq Demo
short_description: Become a commander in a realistic RTS strategy game highlighting Ukraine's peacekeeping mission in Iraq. Lead your troops, call in powerful support, and face off against artificial intelligence in a 1v1 battle for victory!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Ukrainian*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
